name: Junk Food
overview: Scripture reveals that God originally provided humanity with wholesome, natural foods such as herbs and fruit-bearing trees for nourishment (Genesis 1:29; 9:3). The Lord’s instructions through Moses emphasize thoughtful consideration in what we eat (Leviticus 11:1; Proverbs 23:1), encouraging us to choose sustenance that truly satisfies the soul rather than empty or worthless offerings (Isaiah 55:2). The example of Daniel requesting pulse and water (Daniel 1:12) further highlights the value of simple, nourishing food over indulgence. These passages collectively guide believers to honor God by valuing provision that sustains both body and spirit, rather than consuming what is ultimately unfulfilling or harmful.
